title: The Future of Interventional Psychiatry...Brain Stimulation for All?
subtitle: The next part of my interview with the PsychoFarm podcast is out!
body_html:
Greg Maltzberg, M.D., does a fantastic job of educating clinicians about what they should be doing. I was thrilled to join him on the PsychoFarm podcast a few weeks back for an interview. Part II is out now! In it, we discuss the Frontier Treatments we are deploying already at Fermata in New York and Acacia Clinics in Sunnyvale. We discussed Vagal Nerve Stimulation (VNS), eTNS for ADHD, PRISM-PTSD neurofeedback, TMS, esketamine (Spravato), and more.

I hope you find it valuable and enjoyable.

I am so, so into these visuals.

Thanks again to Greg, for doing a great job illustrating what we are talking about.
